annotations.title: LiDAR
annotations.text: Captures 200,000 points per second with 2 cm precision over a 40 m range, for accurate mapping of the environment.

annotations.title: Polycarbonate dome
annotations.text: Polycarbonate dome to protect the camera in all environments. Scratch-resistant, anti-glare and replaceable in the field.

annotations.title: Caméra 4K stabilisée
annotations.text: Records 4K video at 30 FPS for sharp and detailed inspection footage. 3 axis stabilization and 2 axis controlable to reach any spots.

annotations.title: Suspension system
annotations.text: A passive suspension system that ensures better grip and off-road capability.

annotations.title: 6-wheel drive system
annotations.text: A 6-wheel drive system providing excellent traction in all conditions.

annotations.title: Omni-directional LED
annotations.text: Directional LED providing better long-range illumination.

annotations.title: Status LED
annotations.text: Status LED indicating the robot’s status at any point during the mission.

annotations.title: Aluminium chassis
annotations.text: Lightweight yet strong aluminium chassis. Offering the perfect balance for a durable, robust and hardy robot in all environments. Fully waterproof chassis.

annotations.title: Waterproof interface
annotations.text: Waterproof interface: Waterproof power interface allowing the robot to be switched on and recharged in 1 hour 30 minutes and providing a data connector using 100/1000 Ethernet for fast transfer of captured data.

annotations.title: Lifting eyes
annotations.text: Aluminium lifting eyes for easy and efficient handling of the robot.

annotations.title: Rear camera
annotations.text: An additional navigation camera to provide a reliable video feed even when the robot is reversing.

annotations.title: Breadcrumb track mount
annotations.text: A sturdy mount for attaching the robot’s breadcrumb track.
